name: datevec
expr: v1 = datevec(d1); v2 = datevec(d2); v3 = datevec(d3); v4 = datevec(d4); M = datevec(v); [Yc, Mc, Dc] = datevec(d2);
comment: MATLAB datevec: inverse of datenum. Covered: scalar round-trip (Y,M,D), with-time round-trip (H,MI,S), Unix-epoch anchor (719529 -> 1970-01-01), fractional-day extraction (0.25 -> 06:00), N-vector input -> Nx6 matrix, multi-output [Y,M,D] form. Algorithm: Howard Hinnant civil_from_days + microsecond rounding for FP-noise dampening. Edge: datevec(0) = [0 0 0 0 0 0] matches MATLAB literal.
